_comment: Hornero recommended Claude Code settings. Copy into ~/.claude/settings.json or merge with your existing file. The 'hooks.Stop' entry is the feedback-loop trigger — it pings the agent to consider /extract-lesson at session end.

Stop.command: echo 'Session ending. Consider /extract-lesson if anything was surprising or worth capturing.'

_notes: permissions.defaultMode: 'auto' lets the harness auto-approve known-safe tools.
skipAutoPermissionPrompt: true suppresses prompts for operations already in the allow list.
effortLevel: 'high' biases the model toward more thorough output (more tokens, better quality).
model: 'sonnet' is the default for new tasks; switch to opus for planning / haiku for trivial edits.
The Stop hook prints a reminder at session end. Replace with an actual command (e.g., open a feedback note) when you adopt the feedback-ritual playbook.
